evidence_boundary_es: El registro acredita presentación, destinatario registral, asunto, anexo y huella. No acredita admisión, asignación, aceptación de la tesis, producción documental ni decisión de fondo. No se calcula un plazo definitivo sólo desde RedSARA.
evidence_boundary_en: The register establishes presentation, registry recipient, subject, attachment and fingerprint. It does not establish admission, allocation, acceptance of the thesis, document production or a merits decision. No definitive deadline is calculated solely from RedSARA.
privacy: Original receipts contain personal identifiers and remain in protected custody. Public metadata excludes NIE, residential address and private email.
